children: Ticket sales for Scotting 2026 are open
Please purchase tickets separately if your party members will check in at different times.
Pre-registered attendees should navigate to the check-in booth at ScottyCon to receive their admission badges.
Due to recent increases in online processing fees, all credit card transactions will incur Square's 3.3% + 30¢ fee.

Only one CMU Pass may be purchased at a time, for the purchaser's use. A valid student ID is required to pick up tickets. An additional $5 will be charged at the door if the purchaser cannot present their student ID.
IDs are unnecessary for the general pass and multiple general passes can be purchased in a single transaction.
Unfortunately, we cannot offer refunds for any tickets.
